text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Do you have a moment right now?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If you have any wisdom regarding 
communication in athlete development, 
would you please share it with me?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I want to start studying now. So that I 
can follow in the footsteps of the seniors 
who ran the Tiara route and are now 
dedicating themselves to raising the next 
generation...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're so good at communicating, Trainer♪ 
I'll definitely, definitely be taking 
notes!
